Marcus —

Thanks for the quick help last week during our control walkthrough. Our auditors (BrightAudit) flagged one exception in the change management control sampling for the period 2026-06-01 to 2026-11-30. To close our assessment we need the following from Redwood: 

1) The finalized SOC 2 Type II report for the 2026-06:2026-11 period (or confirmation of the report delivery timeline).
2) A signed bridge/attestation letter that acknowledges the finding, references the audit period above, and summarizes management responses and interim compensating controls.
3) Copies of the specific remediation evidence items referenced in the management response (ticket IDs, runbooks, test logs).

Can you confirm ETA and whether any additional documentation (admins' attestations, change-approval logs) is required for BrightAudit to re-evaluate the sample? We are on a compressed deadline for our board review and would appreciate a 48-hour turnaround if possible.

Best,

- CHG-1192: Incomplete test step identified; remediation: automated pre-deploy test added and enforced; verified 2027-05-03. Evidence: test_run_log_1192.csv.
- CHG-1210: Mislabelled change; remediation: policy updated and tagging enforcement added; verified 2027-05-04. Evidence: change_tagging_audit.csv.
